title: Salt Lake City-based Zanskar, which uses AI to find overlooked geothermal fields to boost US electricity supply, raised $115M, taking its total funding to $180M (Benoît Morenne/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Benoît Morenne / Wall Street Journal: Salt Lake City-based Zanskar, which uses AI to find overlooked geothermal fields to boost US electricity supply, raised $115M, taking its total funding to $180M — The startup uses AI to find overlooked geothermal fields and says its discoveries can help sate the U.S.'s thirst for electricity
